rules.coverage_note: SEBI circular IES/DC/CIR-5/00 dated 2000-12-11 specifies initially introduced European-style index options settled in cash. Contract master and final settlement price remain required for each contract.

Remaining cash-settled stocks moved to mandatory physical settlement from October 2019 expiry onwards. SEBI's phased schedule moved some eligible stocks earlier; this generic table intentionally blocks pre-October 2019 stock expiries because it lacks a contract-specific phase assignment.

Expiry-day calendar-spread margin benefit is treated as unavailable from the stated effective date. The paper preflight requires positive source-hashed per-contract delivery-margin evidence and does not infer an exchange margin amount. Evidence must reflect applicable no-offset margin; current official margin capture remains external.
